features.description: Cloud sessions no longer drop out of plan mode after an idle worker restart, preserving the safety mode.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed cloud sessions (Claude Code on the web, desktop and mobile apps) resuming out of plan mode after an idle worker restart

features.description: Resume no longer loads sessions from a different directory whose path differs only by `_`, `-`, or `.`.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `claude -c`/resume picking up sessions from a different directory whose path differed only by characters like `_`, `-`, or `.`

features.description: Clicking the terminal to regain focus no longer answers a pending permission prompt in fullscreen mode.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed fullscreen mode answering a permission prompt or pressing a button when you clicked the terminal window only to bring it back into focus

features.description: Linux sandbox no longer makes a nonexistent `.git/config.worktree` unreadable, unbreaking sandboxed git.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed the Linux sandbox making a nonexistent `.git/config.worktree` unreadable, which broke every sandboxed git command in repos with `extensions.worktreeConfig` set

features.description: `claudeMdExcludes` now excludes symlinked `.claude/rules` files matched by directory or symlink name.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `claudeMdExcludes` not excluding a symlinked `.claude/rules` file when the pattern names the rules directory or the symlink rather than its target

features.description: Masked password-style inputs can no longer be yanked elsewhere with Ctrl+Y or saved into prompt history.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed masked (password-style) inputs such as the login code field letting their text be pasted back with Ctrl+Y elsewhere or saved to prompt history when cleared with double Esc

features.description: A request rejected by an organization policy check is no longer re-sent before the rejection surfaces.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a request rejected by an organization policy check being re-sent before the rejection was shown

features.description: Post-compaction reminder no longer re-runs a skill's original arguments as a fresh user request.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved the reminder shown after compaction so a skill's original arguments are not re-run as a new request

features.description: Remote sessions send keep-alives during long SessionStart or Setup hooks so the container is not idle-reaped.
features.reference_changelog_line: Remote sessions keep sending keep-alives while a long `SessionStart` or `Setup` hook runs, so the container is not idle-reaped mid-hook

features.description: New `/claude-api upgrade` migrates Python projects from anthropic 0.x to 1.x, including timeout API changes.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `/claude-api upgrade` to migrate Python projects from `anthropic` 0.x to 1.x, and updated the skill's Python reference for 1.x (timeouts use `anthropic.Timeout`, not `httpx.Timeout`)

features.description: Plugins synced from claude.ai use a `name@synced` suffix addressable via `claude plugin enable/disable`.
features.reference_changelog_line: Cloud sessions: plugins synced from claude.ai now show as `name@synced`, work with `claude plugin enable/disable <name>@synced`, and never override a same-named plugin you installed

features.description: On the web, Bash and tool requests to non-API anthropic.com hosts route through the session's network proxy.
features.reference_changelog_line: Claude Code on the web: requests from Bash and other tools to non-API anthropic.com hosts (e.g. www, docs) now go through the session's network proxy, so your environment's allowed domains apply

features.description: `ListAgents` now reports the session's own peer-addressable name, and SendMessage to self says so.
features.reference_changelog_line: `ListAgents` now tells a session its own name (the one peers use to message it), and `SendMessage` to your own name says so instead of "no agent named …"

features.description: `ListAgents` and `/list-agents` now include live teammates alongside subagents and other sessions.
features.reference_changelog_line: `ListAgents` and `/list-agents` now list your live teammates (previously only subagents and other sessions appeared, so a reachable teammate looked absent)
